statement: xpad exposes stick axes ABS_X, ABS_Y, ABS_RX, ABS_RY with range -32768..32767, fuzz 16 flat 128; left/right trigger ABS_Z, ABS_RZ with 0..255 (unless mapped as BTN_TL2/TR2). Linux xpad inverts stick Y on decode and leaves stick X as signed LE16.
